+        self,
+        selected_content: Dict,
+        achievement_edits: Dict[Any, Any],
+    ) -> Dict:
+        """Overlay session-edited experience bullets onto selected content."""
+        if not achievement_edits:
+            return selected_content
+
+        updated = copy.deepcopy(selected_content)
+        master_experiences = self.master_data.get('experience') or []
+        experiences = updated.get('experiences') or []
+        experience_by_id = {
+            str(exp.get('id') or '').strip(): exp
+            for exp in experiences
+            if isinstance(exp, dict) and str(exp.get('id') or '').strip()
+        }
+
+        for raw_key, raw_items in (achievement_edits or {}).items():
+            try:
+                exp_idx = int(raw_key)
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                continue
+            if not (0 <= exp_idx < len(master_experiences)):
+                continue
+
+            master_exp = master_experiences[exp_idx] or {}
+            exp_id = str(master_exp.get('id') or '').strip()
+            if not exp_id or exp_id not in experience_by_id:
+                continue
+
+            visible_achievements = []
+            items = raw_items if isinstance(raw_items, list) else [raw_items]
+            for item in items:
+                if isinstance(item, dict):
+                    text = str(item.get('text') or item.get('description') or item.get('content') or '').strip()
+                    hidden = bool(item.get('hidden'))
+                else:
+                    text = str(item or '').strip()
+                    hidden = False
+                if text and not hidden:
+                    visible_achievements.append({'text': text})
+
+            target_exp = experience_by_id[exp_id]
+            target_exp['achievements'] = visible_achievements
+            if 'ordered_achievements' in target_exp:
+                target_exp['ordered_achievements'] = copy.deepcopy(visible_achievements)
+
+        return updated

```
import json
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

from tests.ui.conftest import (
    _force_stage,
    _install_mock_routes,
    _setup_global_state,
    _sync_workflow_steps,
    _wait_for_ui_ready,
)
from tests.ui.fixtures.mock_responses import API_STATUS_ANALYSIS_DONE

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5001"
OUT_DIR = Path("/tmp/hide_only_smoke")
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

MASTER_FIELDS = {
    "experiences": [
        {
            "id": "exp-001",
            "title": "Senior Engineer",
            "company": "Example Co",
            "achievements": [
                {"text": "Built the original feature toggle service."},
                {"text": "Reduced release risk with staged rollouts."},
            ],
        }
    ],
    "selected_achievements": [],
    "selected_experiences": [],
    "selected_skills": [],
    "keywords": [],
}

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1400})
    page.set_default_timeout(10000)

    _install_mock_routes(page, status_response=API_STATUS_ANALYSIS_DONE)
    page.route(
        "**/api/master-fields**",
        lambda route: route.fulfill(
            status=200,
            content_type="application/json",
            body=json.dumps(MASTER_FIELDS),
        ),
    )

    page.goto(f"{BASE_URL}/?session=test-session-id", wait_until="networkidle")
    _wait_for_ui_ready(page)
    _setup_global_state(page, "customization")
    _force_stage(page, "customizations")
    _sync_workflow_steps(page, API_STATUS_ANALYSIS_DONE)

    page.evaluate(
        """
        () => {
            window._savedDecisions = { experience_decisions: {} };
            window.achievementEdits = {
                0: [
                    { text: 'Built the original feature toggle service.', hidden: false },
                    { text: 'Reduced release risk with staged rollouts.', hidden: false },
                ],
            };
        }
        """
    )
    page.evaluate("() => switchTab('ach-editor')")
    page.wait_for_selector("#ach-list-0")
    expect(page.locator("text=Experience Bullets")).to_be_visible()
    expect(page.locator("#ach-row-0-0")).to_be_visible()
    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT_DIR / "01-editor-initial.png"), full_page=True)

    hide_button = page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button[title='Hide bullet from generated CV']")
    hide_button.click()
    page.wait_for_selector("#ach-row-0-0.achievement-row-hidden")
    expect(page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button[title='Show bullet in generated CV']")).to_be_visible()
    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT_DIR / "02-hidden-state.png"), full_page=True)

    show_button = page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button[title='Show bullet in generated CV']")
    show_button.click()
    page.wait_for_function(
        """() => {
            const row = document.querySelector('#ach-row-0-0');
            const btn = document.querySelector("#ach-row-0-0 button[title='Hide bullet from generated CV']");
            return row && !row.classList.contains('achievement-row-hidden') && !!btn;
        }"""
    )
    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT_DIR / "03-restored-visible.png"), full_page=True)

    delete_button = page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button[title='Delete']")
    delete_button.click()
    expect(page.locator("text=Delete this bullet from this session?")).to_be_visible()
    expect(page.locator("role=button[name='Delete']")).to_be_visible()

    browser.close()

+
+    seeded_page.route(

+            body=json.dumps(master_fields),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    seeded_page.evaluate(

+            window.pendingRecommendations = {
+                recommended_achievements: [],
+                recommended_skills: [],
+                recommended_experiences: [],
+                suggested_achievements: [],
+            };
+            window.tabData = window.tabData || {};
+            window.tabData.customizations = true;
+            window._savedDecisions = { experience_decisions: {} };
+            window.userSelections = { experiences: {} };
+            window.achievementEdits = {};
+        }
+        """

+
+    seeded_page.evaluate("() => switchTab('ach-editor')")

+
+    first_row = seeded_page.locator("#ach-row-0-0")
+    first_text = seeded_page.locator("#ach-text-0-0")
+    expect(first_row).to_be_visible()
+    expect(first_text).to_have_value("Built the original feature toggle service.")
+
+    hide_button = seeded_page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button").nth(2)
+    hide_button.click()
+
+    expect(first_row).to_have_class("achievement-row-hidden")
+    expect(first_text).to_have_css("background-color", "rgb(255, 251, 235)")
+
+    hide_button = seeded_page.locator("#ach-row-0-0 button").nth(2)

+    expect(first_row).not_to_have_class("achievement-row-hidden")
